methodology_note: Study units derived from Toronto Notes source structure (toc_inventory.json / derived/scope_packets/PS.json), corrected against raw OCR body-verification (derived/toronto-notes-2025/clean-ocr) of pdf1356-1418 (all pages with a merged_duplicate_headings flag, an OCR-garbled title, or a suspicious topic-to-section-family mismatch, plus spot checks at section-boundary transitions). Five genuine structural defects were confirmed and corrected, matching the project's flagged risk patterns: (1) PS.S01 (title OCR-garbled 'Acromyms') merges the chapter's Acronyms glossary with the real 'Psychiatric Assessment' heading (children History/MSE correctly captured as T01/T02, SU-PS-01/02); (2) PS.S02 (title 'Assessmentand Plan', merged_duplicate_headings=['SUICIDE']) merges 'Assessment and Plan' with a substantial, safety-critical 'Suicide' heading entirely absent from toc_inventory.json as its own node -- split into SU-PS-03/04; (3) 'Personality Disorders' (PS.S13.T05) is mis-parented as a child of the Eating Disorders section rather than represented as its own major diagnostic family -- corrected as SU-PS-51; (4) the 'Psychotherapy' heading (Table 13, ten modalities) is entirely absent from toc_inventory.json, silently folded into PS.S15 'Neurodevelopmental Disorders' page range -- recovered as SU-PS-59; (5) 'Electroconvulsive Therapy' is entirely absent from PS.S17's topic list (T01-T04 cover only rTMS/MST/Neurosurgical/Other) despite being the section's first and most clinically significant topic -- recovered as SU-PS-64. Two further body-recovered headings with no toc_inventory.json node were also captured: 'Developmental Concepts' (attachment/temperament, child-interview guidance; SU-PS-52) folded into PS.S14's page range, and the 'Neurodevelopmental Disorders' section-opening ADHD/ASD cross-references to Pediatrics, correctly distinguished from the section's real body content (Disruptive, Impulse-Control, and Conduct Disorder, T01-T03) per toc_inventory.json's own merged_duplicate_headings flag on PS.S15. All remaining LOW-confidence, TOC_OCR_UNANCHORED topic children (the large majority of this chapter's ~64 topic nodes) were accepted at toc_inventory.json's own segmentation -- each already isolates one coherent DSM-5-type diagnosis or drug class matching this project's non-fragmentation guidance -- with page_mapping_precision honestly recorded as SECTION_INHERITED rather than claiming topic-level page precision that was not independently body-verified.

study_units.title: Psychiatric History Taking
study_units.structural_rationale: toc_inventory.json's PS.S01 node (captured title 'Acromyms', an OCR garble of 'Acronyms') merges two real, distinct top-level headings confirmed by raw OCR body-verification of pdf1356-1358 (PS2-4): the chapter's front-matter Acronyms glossary (non-clinical, excluded via PS.S01 as organizational header) and the real 'Psychiatric Assessment' section, whose own children are 'History' and 'Mental Status Exam' -- already correctly captured by toc_inventory.json as PS.S01.T01/T02. This unit represents the History component only (Introduction, Identifying Data, Chief Complaint, HPI, Psychiatric Functional Inquiry, Past Psychiatric History, Substance Use History, Past Medical/Family/Developmental History, Collateral History), confirmed starting pdf1356 (PS2) and continuing onto pdf1357 (PS3) before Mental Status Exam begins.

study_units.title: Mental Status Examination
study_units.structural_rationale: Confirmed by raw OCR body-verification (pdf1357-1358, PS3-4) as the second real child of the 'Psychiatric Assessment' heading merged into toc_inventory.json's garbled PS.S01 node (see SU-PS-01 for the Acronyms/Psychiatric Assessment merge). Covers General Appearance, Speech, Emotion (mood/affect), Perception, Thought Process/Form, Thought Content (including suicidal/homicidal ideation screening within thought content), Insight, Judgment, and Cognition (AASEPTIC mnemonic).

study_units.title: Approach to Psychiatric Assessment and Management Planning
study_units.structural_rationale: toc_inventory.json's PS.S02 node (title OCR-garbled as 'Assessmentand Plan') has no T-level children and its own merged_duplicate_headings flag lists 'SUICIDE', correctly signalling that two distinct headings are folded into one node. Raw OCR body-verification of pdf1359 (PS5) confirms 'Assessment and Plan' (historical multiaxial model, problem formulation across biological/psychological/social domains, approach to management) occupies the first half of the page and ends at 'Assessing Insight and Judgment' sidebar, immediately followed by a new 'Suicide' heading -- represented separately as SU-PS-04 given its safety-critical, independently testable content. This unit covers only the Assessment/Problem Formulation and Approach to Management content.

study_units.title: Suicide Risk Assessment and Management
study_units.structural_rationale: Body-recovered heading: toc_inventory.json has no node for 'Suicide' -- it is silently folded into PS.S02 ('Assessmentand Plan'), flagged only indirectly via that node's merged_duplicate_headings=['SUICIDE']. Raw OCR body-verification confirms 'Suicide' begins partway through pdf1359 (PS5, immediately after the 'Assessing Insight and Judgment' sidebar) and continues through pdf1360 (PS6), covering: importance/universal screening, approach to asking about ideation (passive vs. active), assessing plan/intent/means/protective factors, SAD PERSONS risk factors, assessment of a completed suicide attempt, epidemiology, and management (hospitalization/Form 1 threshold vs. outpatient safety planning). Given a synthetic UNCATALOGUED id per the OT/OR/OP/PM/PL precedent for body-recovered headings absent from toc_inventory.json. Kept as a single coherent unit per the project's non-fragmentation guidance (epidemiology/risk factors/management of one clinical topic) rather than split by subheading.
